title: Applicability.
bodyText: Subject to section 200A-28, this chapter applies to any transaction, certificate of title, or record relating to a vessel, even if the transaction, certificate of title, or record was entered into or created before July 1, 2018.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: "July 1, 2018" substituted for "the effective date of this chapter" pursuant to §23G-15.

bodyHtml:
[§200A-3]  Applicability.  Subject to section 200A-28, this chapter applies to any transaction, certificate of title, or record relating to a vessel, even if the transaction, certificate of title, or record was entered into or created before July 1, 2018. [L 2018, c 46, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  "July 1, 2018" substituted for "the effective date of this chapter" pursuant to §23G-15.
